scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli build && corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-mcp build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli test && corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-mcp test && node scripts/test-python.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli build && corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-mcp typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write cli/src cli/test mcp/src mcp/test scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check cli/src cli/test mcp/src mcp/test scripts
scripts.regression:recent: corepack pnpm --filter @zaydiscold/amazon-kindle-cli exec vitest run test/authVerify.test.ts test/wishlist.test.ts && node scripts/test-python.mjs && corepack pnpm format:check
